sourceTitle: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
originalTitle: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
author: OpenAI

blocks.text: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK National Research Institute have signed an agreement to explore collaboration on AI safety, security and technical research. The partnership will bring together expertise from both organizations to better understand emerging risks, strengthen safeguards, and explore how advanced AI can contribute to a more secure and resilient digital ecosystem.
blocks.en: OpenAI and Poland’s NASK National Research Institute have signed an agreement to explore collaboration on AI safety, security and technical research. The partnership will bring together expertise from both organizations to better understand emerging risks, strengthen safeguards, and explore how advanced AI can contribute to a more secure and resilient digital ecosystem.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 与波兰 NASK 国家研究所已签署协议，探索在 AI 安全、安全防护及技术研究方面开展合作。此次合作将汇集双方的专业知识，以更好地了解新兴风险、加强防护措施，并探索如何利用先进 AI 构建更安全、更具韧性的数字生态系统。

blocks.text: As AI systems become more capable, international collaboration between developers and public research institutions will be essential to understanding their risks and building stronger safeguards. OpenAI’s existing work with the US Center for Advancing Standards and Innovation for Super Intelligence (CAISSI), UK AI Security Institute (AISI) and other public research institutions around the world has already helped strengthen safeguards, identify and fix security vulnerabilities in AI agents, and advance frontier AI safety.
blocks.en: As AI systems become more capable, international collaboration between developers and public research institutions will be essential to understanding their risks and building stronger safeguards. OpenAI’s existing work with the US Center for Advancing Standards and Innovation for Super Intelligence (CAISSI), UK AI Security Institute (AISI) and other public research institutions around the world has already helped strengthen safeguards, identify and fix security vulnerabilities in AI agents, and advance frontier AI safety.
blocks.zh: 随着 AI 系统能力不断增强，开发者与公共研究机构之间的国际合作，对于理解这些系统的风险、建立更有力的防护措施将至关重要。OpenAI 与美国超级智能标准与创新促进中心（CAISSI）、英国 AI 安全研究所（AISI）及全球其他公共研究机构的现有合作，已帮助加强防护措施、发现并修复 AI 智能体中的安全漏洞，并推动前沿 AI 安全的发展。

blocks.text: Through the agreement, NASK’s AI Safety Research Center – serving as the Polish Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute (AISI) – and OpenAI will collaborate on AI safety research, exploring ways to evaluate increasingly capable AI systems, identify potential vulnerabilities and strengthen safeguards.
blocks.en: Through the agreement, NASK’s AI Safety Research Center – serving as the Polish Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute (AISI) – and OpenAI will collaborate on AI safety research, exploring ways to evaluate increasingly capable AI systems, identify potential vulnerabilities and strengthen safeguards.
blocks.zh: 根据协议，承担波兰人工智能安全研究所（AISI）职能的 NASK AI 安全研究中心将与 OpenAI 合作开展 AI 安全研究，探索如何评估能力日益增强的 AI 系统、识别潜在漏洞并加强防护措施。

blocks.text: “Collaboration with OpenAI is a natural step for the Institute and its AI Safety Research Center, which is actively involved in AI safety research. This work spans developing safeguards against emerging risks, detecting synthetic AI-generated content, and understanding both its malicious uses and the multilingual aspects of these challenges. AI safety cannot be achieved in isolation. It is a collaborative effort, and only through active cooperation between public AI Safety Institutes and frontier AI developers can we ensure that AI becomes truly reliable and safe to use. By combining our research expertise with OpenAI’s technical capabilities, we can better anticipate risks, strengthen safeguards, and build public trust in these transformative technologies.”
blocks.en: “Collaboration with OpenAI is a natural step for the Institute and its AI Safety Research Center, which is actively involved in AI safety research. This work spans developing safeguards against emerging risks, detecting synthetic AI-generated content, and understanding both its malicious uses and the multilingual aspects of these challenges. AI safety cannot be achieved in isolation. It is a collaborative effort, and only through active cooperation between public AI Safety Institutes and frontier AI developers can we ensure that AI becomes truly reliable and safe to use. By combining our research expertise with OpenAI’s technical capabilities, we can better anticipate risks, strengthen safeguards, and build public trust in these transformative technologies.”
blocks.zh: “对于 NASK 研究所及其积极开展 AI 安全研究的 AI 安全研究中心而言，与 OpenAI 合作是顺理成章的一步。这些研究涵盖针对新兴风险制定防护措施、检测 AI 生成的合成内容，以及了解此类内容如何被恶意利用、相关挑战涉及哪些多语言问题。 AI 安全无法靠单打独斗实现。这需要共同努力。只有公共 AI 安全研究所与前沿 AI 开发者积极合作，才能确保 AI 真正可靠、使用安全。 将我们的研究专长与 OpenAI 的技术能力相结合，能让我们更好地预判风险、加强防护措施，并建立公众对这些变革性技术的信任。”

blocks.text: “Poland is home to exceptional scientists and technical talent, many of whom have helped lead OpenAI’s own research. As AI becomes more capable, it’s vital that we draw on expertise beyond our own organization to challenge our assumptions, test our systems and strengthen safeguards. This agreement with NASK opens the door to doing that together, bringing Poland’s research expertise into the international effort to make AI safer.”
blocks.en: “Poland is home to exceptional scientists and technical talent, many of whom have helped lead OpenAI’s own research. As AI becomes more capable, it’s vital that we draw on expertise beyond our own organization to challenge our assumptions, test our systems and strengthen safeguards. This agreement with NASK opens the door to doing that together, bringing Poland’s research expertise into the international effort to make AI safer.”
blocks.zh: “波兰拥有杰出的科学家和技术人才，其中许多人曾在 OpenAI 的研究中发挥引领作用。随着 AI 能力不断增强，我们必须借助组织外部的专业知识，审视自身假设、测试系统并加强防护措施。与 NASK 签署的这项协议为双方共同开展这些工作创造了机会，将波兰的研究专长融入提升 AI 安全的国际行动。”

blocks.text: —Tom Duff Gordon, VP and Head of EMEA Policy at OpenAI
blocks.en: —Tom Duff Gordon, VP and Head of EMEA Policy at OpenAI
blocks.zh: —Tom Duff Gordon，OpenAI 副总裁兼欧洲、中东和非洲政策负责人

blocks.text: OpenAI has called for the US to work with countries around the world on international technical standards for frontier AI, drawing on the expertise of AI safety institutes and standards bodies. Common approaches to evaluating capabilities, assessing risks, testing safeguards and reporting incidents can help countries compare evidence and respond to risks that cross borders. The collaboration with NASK reflects the value of bringing national expertise into this wider effort.
blocks.en: OpenAI has called for the US to work with countries around the world on international technical standards for frontier AI, drawing on the expertise of AI safety institutes and standards bodies. Common approaches to evaluating capabilities, assessing risks, testing safeguards and reporting incidents can help countries compare evidence and respond to risks that cross borders. The collaboration with NASK reflects the value of bringing national expertise into this wider effort.
blocks.zh: OpenAI 曾呼吁美国与世界各国合作，借助 AI 安全研究所和标准机构的专业知识，制定前沿 AI 国际技术标准。在能力评估、风险评估、防护措施测试和事件报告方面采用通用方法，有助于各国对照分析证据，应对跨境风险。与 NASK 的合作体现了将各国专业力量融入这一更广泛国际行动的价值。

blocks.text: In NASK’s case, this expertise rests on extensive research in AI safety, applied directly to protecting public services and Poland’s digital information ecosystem. Without national partners like NASK, global AI safety standards may remain detached from the realities in which AI is actually used.
blocks.en: In NASK’s case, this expertise rests on extensive research in AI safety, applied directly to protecting public services and Poland’s digital information ecosystem. Without national partners like NASK, global AI safety standards may remain detached from the realities in which AI is actually used.
blocks.zh: NASK 的专业能力源于广泛的 AI 安全研究，这些研究直接用于保护公共服务和波兰的数字信息生态系统。如果没有 NASK 这样的国家级合作伙伴，全球 AI 安全标准可能始终无法贴合 AI 的实际使用环境。

blocks.text: The agreement also builds on OpenAI’s existing work with cyber defenders in Poland. In July, CERT Polska, which operates within NASK, gained access to OpenAI’s cyber capable models through Daybreak. The team used OpenAI models to help discover six vulnerabilities in MikroTik RouterOS, including flaws that could be combined to take control of affected devices without authentication. The vendor released fixes, which CERT Polska confirmed prevented the attacks it observed.
blocks.en: The agreement also builds on OpenAI’s existing work with cyber defenders in Poland. In July, CERT Polska, which operates within NASK, gained access to OpenAI’s cyber capable models through Daybreak. The team used OpenAI models to help discover six vulnerabilities in MikroTik RouterOS, including flaws that could be combined to take control of affected devices without authentication. The vendor released fixes, which CERT Polska confirmed prevented the attacks it observed.
blocks.zh: 该协议也延续了 OpenAI 与波兰网络防御人员已有的合作。7 月，隶属于 NASK 的 CERT Polska 通过 Daybreak 获得了使用权限，可以使用 OpenAI 具备网络安全能力的模型。该团队借助 OpenAI 模型在 MikroTik RouterOS 中发现了六个漏洞，其中一些漏洞组合利用后，可让攻击者在未经身份验证的情况下控制受影响的设备。厂商随后发布了修复程序，CERT Polska 确认这些修复能够阻止其观察到的攻击。
